    Parameters:

    Examples

    Example: BlinkingExample

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/BlinkingExample-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class BlinkingExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            text = Text("Blinking").scale(1.5)
            self.add(text)
            self.play(Blink(text, blinks=3))
    ```
